answer_1.quote: our approach emphasizes creating engaging and reliable copywriting from customer reviews.
answer_1.outputs: copywriting (summaries) for given aspects and reviews

answer_2.quote: ROUGE score is a conventional metric to measure the quality of text summarization. Perplexity (PPL) is commonly used to evaluate text fluency.

answer_4.quote: We use evaluators in the United States and the United Kingdom, with a greater than 95% approval rate.
answer_4.guideline: The instructions for evaluators are (1) Which one is more attractive and makes you want to purchase/enjoy k? (2) Which one is more faithful to the original review x? (3) Which one is more fluent?
